summary: Pilgrim's Pride filed an 8-K disclosing formation of a special committee of independent, disinterested directors to evaluate the unsolicited August 18, 2026 proposal from controlling shareholder JBS N.V. to acquire all PPC shares it does not already own. The committee retained Ropes & Gray as legal counsel and Moelis & Company LLC as financial advisor. No price, stake percentage, or premium was disclosed. The board will not approve any transaction absent the committee's favorable recommendation, and closing is expected to be conditioned on approval by a majority of votes cast by non-JBS holders. Watch for committee response, any revised JBS price, and minority-vote conditions.
